children: Major Gulf stock markets were mixed on Wednesday as escalating regional conflict and mounting energy security concerns tempered investor appetite.
The six-month-old conflict intensified sharply on Tuesday as Iranian-backed Houthi forces launched strikes against several Saudi cities, drawing a key U.S. ally deeper into the hostilities.
In a rapid escalation, U.S. forces struck multiple Iranian oil tankers, while Iran retaliated by attacking maritime vessels and targeting a U.S. military base in Jordan.
The cross-border strikes threaten to severely disrupt Middle Eastern oil output and transit, compounding existing strains on regional energy infrastructure and critical maritime corridors.
